title: OSM/ODbL tile-policy and share-alike verification (BLOCKING for any OSM-derived bundling)
detail: Three capture attempts failed with transport errors (OSError) on 2026-10-06: operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/, osmfoundation.org/wiki/Tile_usage_policy, wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tile_usage_policy. ODbL attribution/share-alike and bulk-download constraints for OSM-derived offline tile bundles are therefore UNVERIFIED in this stage.
bounded_alternative: v1 bundles only Natural Earth-derived tiles (public domain, captured terms S7). Any ODbL source requires the license review + a per-bundle license state before adoption.

title: GeoPackage (or single-file container) as alternative project container
detail: A GeoPackage-style container could improve interchange with the GIS ecosystem (including its undefined-CRS registry provisions), but the primary spec was not captured this stage; no GeoPackage-specific claims are made in the proposal.
bounded_alternative: Folder bundle (SQLite + manifest.json + blobs/ + tiles/) chosen for v1; container swap isolated behind the storage layer.

title: Field-tool product precedents (QGIS offline editing plugin / Mergin Maps-class)
detail: Would strengthen the offline-edit/merge workflow comparison with existing field products; budget went to the PROJ/GDAL/SQLite/CouchDB mechanism chain instead. Useful for the critique stage to test FieldBook's conflict UX against a shipped product.
bounded_alternative: CouchDB conflict model (S6) used as the shipped-system precedent for divergence handling.

title: Track OSGeo/gdal#15337 (open) for its fix and regression test
detail: Open as of capture (2026-10-04): OpenFileGDB spatial index misses features with PROJ 9.7.1 (axis-order derived index bounds). Confirms the failure class is live; no merged fix assumed. If FieldBook adds any library-derived index path, adopt the reporter's lesson: set explicit axis mapping on every cloned CRS before transforming bounds.
bounded_alternative: FieldBook builds its own index coordinates from explicit registry metadata (design §6), independent of that fix.

title: Vertical-datum transformation as a later capability
detail: PROJ PR #4708 (merged 2026-03-13, backport-9.8 label, tests in test/unit/test_operationfactory.cpp) chains vertical CRS transforms via intermediate same-datum CRSs and replaces a silent ballpark fallback with registered operations (+proj=geogoffset +dh=28, axisswap 1,2,-3 example). v1 keeps altitude as provenance-labelled attribute without transformation; revisit after pinning PROJ >= 9.8.x and validating accuracy.
bounded_alternative: Store datum/units verbatim; refuse transformation rather than ballpark (contract §4).

title: Renderer and PROJ license pages not captured
detail: Leaflet-class renderer and PROJ license statements were not captured this stage (time/transport); both are standard permissive licenses by common knowledge but that is NOT source-verified here.
bounded_alternative: Capture before shipping any binary; add to license_manifest gate (V7).

title: PROJ #4632 backport status to 9.7.x unknown
detail: Captured data shows the fix in milestone 9.8.0 and stable 9.8.1 (reporter claim in #4842); a 'backport 9.8' label exists on sibling PR #4708 but no backport evidence for #4632 was captured.
bounded_alternative: Version-pin PROJ per project + transform_id revalidation job on upgrade (§4).

title: Photo EXIF capture-point provenance verification
detail: EXIF GPS is displayed as claimed metadata with provenance; forensic verification (sensor vs EXIF consistency) is future work. Automated classification explicitly out of v1 scope.
bounded_alternative: Manual review workflow; photos never participate in geometry queries.
